title: AI让人类变笨？：Roose真正担心的是，学生连功课都不做了？
speaker: Kevin Roose

segments.en: Yeah, people I talked to have concerns about that. It's not the foremost
segments.zh: 是的，我交谈过的人对此有担忧。这不是最重要的

segments.en: They're mostly concerned about human extinction and mass job law
segments.zh: 他们主要担心人类灭绝和大规模失业

segments.en: I just I feel like this is I mean, but like you talk to people in your daily life
segments.zh: 我只是觉得，我的意思是，你在日常生活中和人聊天

segments.en: And they're like oh, I had chat GPT read an email to my boss or oh, I had chat GPT respond to somebody on a dating app
segments.zh: 他们会说，哦，我让ChatGPT给我老板读邮件，或者我让ChatGPT在约会软件上回复别人

segments.en: And it's like it's I am just shocked at how quickly people have stopped doing basic tasks
segments.zh: 就像，我只是震惊于人们这么快就停止做基本任务

segments.en: I worry about this a lot for students
segments.zh: 我很为学生担心这一点

segments.en: I think if I had had AI during high school or college
segments.zh: 我想如果我高中或大学时有AI

segments.en: I would have done like very little work
segments.zh: 我可能几乎不会做什么功课

segments.en: And I imagine that that's the experience some students are having today
segments.zh: 我想这就是今天一些学生的经历

segments.en: I think yeah, I unless worried about it for for you know adults. I think it's it's a problem
segments.zh: 我认为，是的，我也为成年人担心。我认为这是个问题

segments.en: But I would I would compare it to something like Google maps where like when it came out everyone is like oh Google maps
segments.zh: 但我会把它比作谷歌地图，它刚出来时大家都说，哦，谷歌地图

segments.en: Like we're all ours our skills at navigation are gonna atrophy
segments.zh: 我们的导航技能会萎缩

segments.en: No one's gonna know where we're going anymore
segments.zh: 没人会知道我们要去哪了

segments.en: But those two things are true correct and if your phone dies and you don't have Google maps like you are screwed
segments.zh: 但这两件事都是真的，如果你手机没电又没有谷歌地图，你就麻烦了

segments.en: You are lost and you are asking someone else to use their phone
segments.zh: 你迷路了，你得问别人借手机
